faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Project Associate position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Senior Project Associate post is 07 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Sc./M.Sc.Tech./Integrated M.Tech. in specific Geophysics fields or an M.Tech. in Petroleum Exploration/Fuel Engineering/Petroleum Engineering with over 80% marks or 8.00 CGPA, along with a 1st class Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Project Associate position is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 42,000 per month, plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Project Associate position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, with the pincode 826004.
